title: Herrera spoke to Kirk McConnell in a SCIF
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Herrera spoke to Kirk McConnell in a SCIF, about recent at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I know. I know. I talked to him in a skiff.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says he spoke with a man named Kirk McConnell in a SCIF, a specially secured room where secret government information can be discussed, in Washington. He mentions it to show that his account was heard in an official, classified setting.
